edges.rationale: ExamDetails is the default export defined in ExamDetails.jsx.
useQuery call lives inside the ExamDetails function body.
enroll/unenroll useMutation blocks are declared within ExamDetails.
Tab branches (overview/updates/syllabus/pattern/pyq) are returned in ExamDetails JSX.
api.get('/api/exam-info') is invoked to enumerate all exam records.
api.get to /api/exams/<id> fetches content with a silent-fail fallback.
api.get to /api/exam-info/<id>/updates populates the Updates tab.
api.get to /api/exam-info/<id>/yearly-data drives the per-year hero stats.
api.get('/api/exam-categories') is used to resolve the exam category label.
checkEnrollment effect calls api.get('/api/users/enrolled-exams') to determine isEnrolled state.
The enroll/unenroll useMutation pair implements the Exam Enrollment Workflow on the frontend.
useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient are imported from @tanstack/react-query.
lucide-react supplies the Bell/Layout/BookOpen/etc. icons rendered throughout the page.
parseExamIds is defined at the top of stages.js.
The GET handlers are registered on the stages router in stages.js.
The POST/PUT/DELETE admin handlers belong to the same router module.
POST /initialize is one of the admin handlers in stages.js.
The auto-inverse sync block runs inside the PUT /:id handler.
DELETE /:id performs the multi-table reference check before softDelete.
POST /sync-all is the final admin endpoint in stages.js.
Handlers invoke Stage.findActive, getStagesWithCategories, getStagesWithTestCounts, findById, findBySlug, categoryLinkedToStage, getAggregatesForStage.
Admin handlers call Stage.create, updateById, softDelete, findById, findBySlug and the static helpers.
GET /:id/categories, /tree, /tests and /details use dbHelpers.find for testCategories, testSeries, tests, exams.
Auto-sync, delete-safety, sync-exam-ids, update-exam-ids and sync-all all use dbHelpers.find and dbHelpers.updateById.
Every admin handler is gated by protect and admin middleware.
sync-all re-implements the same examId <-> stageId sync logic that runs in PUT /:id plus the id remapping step.
The PUT handler auto-sync is the canonical implementation of the Bidirectional Stage<->Exam Linkage invariant.
parseExamIds is invoked inside the PUT /:id handler to normalize examIds/categoryIds updates.
ExamDetails surfaces exam-level data while stages.js owns the stage taxonomy; they are both part of the exam-domain surface but do not call each other directly in these files.
The page documents user-visible enrollment behavior (Enroll/Unenroll buttons) tied to /api/users endpoints not shown in this chunk.
